selection: Fixed lowest numeric existing TRAIN ID with acquired before/during US and full tag, selected using metadata only; retain failure without replacement.
observable: Human-annotated corresponding anatomical landmark position in acquired before/during ultrasound, world millimetres; no measured action/force/time history.
coordinate_convention: Creator paired-world-mm convention: first triplet before-US, second during-US; each original NIfTI sform maps voxel centres to RAS millimetres. Identity conversions express that convention, not anatomical registration accuracy.
coordinate_convention_provenance: Byte-identical convention from manifests/experiments/resect-case4-sparse-update-v1.json, sourced to creator instructions https://yimingxiao.weebly.com/data-repositories.html and creator paper https://users.encs.concordia.ca/~hrivaz/Xiao_Database_MedPhys.pdf. This is interpretation of source convention, not measured tracking/anatomical registration accuracy.

mechanism_record.mechanism: conditional observation update from sparse paired anatomical landmarks
mechanism_record.access_scope: Root reopened creator instructions and paper abstract/method statement on2026-10-10; no new dataset download. Existing source-method qualification is retained.

named_fields.format: MINC and NIfTI world coordinates equivalent per creator instructions

mechanism_record.test: freeze6 source-selected B; predict every remaining V using static/rigid/fixedIDW; report 3D mm errors and exact native image-cell inclusion without row exclusion
mechanism_record.source_limited_claim: registration/observation agreement; no causal tool response or calibrated clinical uncertainty

permitted_proposed_reads: Opaque source fixity; 348 uncompressed NIfTI header bytes per image, no image arrays; trusted tag splitter source columns only, then six B destinations in fit, remaining V destinations only after field freeze.
header_rule: Reuse run_resect_case4_sparse_update.header_record: NIfTI1 3D, mm, active sform1/inactive qform0, finite invertible affine; preserve inactive qform fields without reconstruction. Record actual frame/header failure without flips or alternate registration.

partition.row_ids: one-based original order; starting row1 and lower-ID exact ties

primary_comparison: proper_rigid minus no_shift RMS error on every V row
secondary_comparison: fixed all-six IDW against both; no method selection/tuning using V
outputs: all V row errors in mm

uncertainty.policy: Report uncalibrated. Published picking-repeatability summaries do not include source picking/tracking/frame bias and are not Case2 uncertainty. No independent-point CI from one person; no invented zero uncertainty.

failure_policy: Keep this fixed patient in denominator. Refuse unsupported header/coordinate convention, fewer than12 unique points, invalid rank or file changes. Preserve unavailable rigid fit. Report outside-image/unsupported observations explicitly without data-directed exclusion or case replacement. Model worse than static/rigid remains a complete negative result.

prospective_resource_request.memory_policy: Record worker ru_maxrss honestly; no hard RSS enforcement or live sampler. Data operations limited to two348-byte headers and one1097-byte tag.
prospective_resource_request.output_scope: Aggregate entire three-phase attempt, before every wrapper publication and terminal acceptance; child file size limited to1MiB, not a filesystem quota.
prospective_resource_request.supervision: Reuse real_intake_io.supervise and termination_cleanup; exact runtime/source release remains required.

preserved_roles: Case4 remains exposed DEVELOPMENT; all existing TRAIN/SELECT/MEASUREMENT_EVAL assignments and RESECT-SEG/CuRIOUS alias grouping unchanged; no SELECT/EVAL source access.
next_execution: First source/header qualification and persisted B/V partition only, after bounded root dispatch; no baseline fit or V reveal from this source preparation. Later root-owned fitting then one-shot independent evaluation. No new acquisition or mesh/FEM prerequisite.
